summary: Apply ISO 45001, bow-tie analysis, and critical control assurance. Build practical risk outputs in this five-day advanced course. Enquire today.
lede: Occupational safety risk management helps safety leaders and specialists assess workplace hazards and verify that controls work. This training is for safety managers, risk specialists, and operations leaders who need to prioritize risks and turn findings into treatment plans. Learners practice hazard assessment, bow-tie analysis, and critical-control assurance, then use risk registers and dashboards to report residual risk and support decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess workplace hazards, oversee safety controls, or report occupational risk to operational leaders.
modules: Bow-Tie Analysis for Occupational Safety Risk
Hierarchy of Controls and Critical Controls
Management of Change and Contractor Risk
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of occupational health and safety management systems, workplace hazard assessment, and incident or control records is expected. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel; Power BI access is useful for the dashboard exercise but is not required to complete the course.
